acceptance_criteria.description: Eight v1 capability output schemas reject missing required fields and return structured errors with hints.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::schema_check passed; rejects_missing_required_fields_for_all_v1_capabilities covers all v1 capabilities and returns schema.required.missing.

acceptance_criteria.description: Invalid capability writes emit SchemaValidationFailed and use three-part schema error codes.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::schema_check passed; invalid_write_appends_schema_failure_event asserts SchemaValidationFailed is written.

acceptance_criteria.description: policy.yaml is present and consumed by WIP/open-risk gates, pack oversize events, schema strict mode, loop detection, and subagent timeout metrics.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::policy and cargo test --locked passed; capability.rs reads policy for WIP/open-risk and pack thresholds, schema_check.rs reads schema.strict, events.rs reads loop threshold, fitness.rs tracks subagent timeouts.

acceptance_criteria.description: state.yaml.metrics projection contains the nine baseline metric fields.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::fitness passed; computes_all_m5_metric_buckets covers tasks, capabilities, sync, pack, schema, events, and subagent buckets.

acceptance_criteria.description: events.jsonl corruption is recovered by truncating to the last complete event and writing EventLogCorrupted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::events passed; corrupted_event_log_truncates_and_writes_recovery_event asserts invalid JSON is removed and EventLogCorrupted is appended.

acceptance_criteria.description: Event-frequency loop detection emits LoopWarning for rapid claim/release cycles.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::events passed; rapid_claim_release_cycle_appends_loop_warning asserts LoopWarning event output.
